texts.facts: 2. The present application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.855 of 2011 (Old Case No.53 of 2001) (State Vs. Gulam Mohammad) based on undated application moved by opposite party no.2 (vide order dated 8.1.2001 by C.J.M.) as well as cognizance order dated 8.1.2001 under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 (Pfa Act), Police Station Chakia, District Chandauli as well as consequential orders including execution of order dated 3.9.2025 issuing N.B.W. against applicant pending before the Civil Judge (Junior Division)/Judicial Magistrate, Chakia, Chandauli. texts.arguments: However, learned counsel for applicant admits that in the year 2001 applicant was enlarged on bail and upto 2020 applicant has appeared before the court concerned, thereafter, he could not appear before the court concerned and as such, non bailable warrant has been issued against him. 4. Insofar as putting challenge to the summoning order, the summoning order is of the year 2001.
